Settings

Stored only in this browser and sent only to openrouter.ai. Free models need no credit; get a key at openrouter.ai/keys.

Loading free models…

"Auto" ranks the free vision models by how well each reads a built-in sample card (text, bold, italic, strikethrough, emoji, table), tested once a day; models scoring under 50 are skipped. Results are pooled with other visitors (only the sample card's answers, never your images or text), so models someone tested in the last day are not re-tested. If a model is busy, the next ones are tried, then OpenRouter's own free router. Tesseract's plain reading is sent along as a draft.
